Printed p.4: 'Peculiar dialects of Dzongkha are spoken in the far north, viz. the dialect of the alpine yakherd communities of Lingzhi, Laya and Lunana in the northwest Bhutan. Much of the couleur locale of these northern dialects results from structural and lexical similarities with Tibetan.' The phonology described is explicitly that of the standard Wang/Thê dialect only.
